title: busbar.conformance.verdict/1
description: One suite's arm-or-red fact, the same the suite's `verdict` CI job already computes (mcp-conformance.yml:486-559), written to disk. The release pipeline drops one `<suite>.json` here per suite that ran, then `cargo xtask gate conformance-sync --write` reconciles them into the manifest. A registered suite with no verdict file is not-run, never green. Rules: status "pass" requires armed==true; `commit` is the sha the SUBJECT was built from, which is what makes staleness detectable.

suite.description: Stable suite id, matching the registry.

commit.description: The sha the subject was built from.
